title: Conviction of Sin
definition: Conviction of sin is the work of the Holy Spirit by which He exposes guilt, reveals the seriousness of sin, and shows the need for Christ.
summary: The Spirit awakens sinners to the truth about sin, righteousness, and judgment. True conviction leads not to despair, but to repentance and faith.
christFocus: The Spirit points sinners to Christ as the only Savior who can forgive, cleanse, and restore.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: The Spirit awakens sinners to the truth about sin, righteousness, and judgment. True conviction leads not to despair, but to repentance and faith.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, follow Christ faithfully, and avoid confusion in doctrine and daily life.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
